correctness.rationale: For all integers d≥4 the exact active-facet illumination criterion reduces a lit signed vertex to a heavy edge. Disjoint heavy edges are impossible, so a star/triangle bound gives at most d−1 illuminated vertices per direction. The explicit 2d vectors ±w_i each illuminate exactly d−1 and partition every signed coordinate pair into four distinct signatures. For fractional weights the sum of the vertex coverage constraints forces total weight ≥2d; the partition gives I≤2d and I*≤2d. An exact integer standalone check passed all dimensions 4 through 15, supplementary to this general proof. No genericity or continuity assumptions.
